request: Calculate the yes proportion among usable responses; explain why 40 is not its denominator.
sources: A fictional club received 40 survey forms; 30 contained an answer to the yes/no question, of which 12 answered yes.
The requested proportion is yes responses among usable answers: 12/30.
Ten forms have no answer to this question; their preferences are unknown.

expected.diagnostic: 12/40 is the proportion of all forms containing a yes, a different estimand.
